'''Fuyue''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]], found at the Commercial District.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Fuyue:''' Jinzhou is just incredible, right? The sky's so blue, the food smells amazing, and the energy from people practicing martial arts is off the charts!
:{{DIcon}} You're not from around here?
:'''Fuyue:''' Nope, totally new here. I thought Jinzhou was just some sleepy border town, but wow, it's blowing me away with its charm!
:'''Fuyue:''' And the folks here... despite dealing with all those [[Tacet Discord]]s and [[Exiles]], they still manage to whip up delicious food and build these gorgeous houses.
:'''Fuyue:''' Guess this is what they mean by "living life to the fullest". The moment I arrived here, I just felt like, "Yes! This is it!"
:{{DIcon}} "Yes! This is it!"?
:'''Fuyue:''' Yeah. You know what [[Linglong]] says? "As a designer, I want to create outfits that match people's lifestyles perfectly."
:'''Fuyue:''' She believes clothes should not only fit your body but also uplift your mood and energy. That's why a designer thrives in places where everyone's living their best life!
:'''Fuyue:''' No wonder Linglong chose to open a branch here.
:{{DIcon}} Linglong?
::'''Fuyue:''' Wait, you haven't heard of her? She's a total fashion icon! Her brand "Longyue" is like a global sensation. People literally camp out to get their hands on her latest drops.
::'''Fuyue:''' Linglong aims to make fashion more exciting and accessible. That's why she's opening up stores all over the world!
:{{DIcon}} A branch?
::'''Fuyue:''' Guess what? Longyue, Linglong's original brand, is making its way to Jinzhou soon!
::'''Fuyue:''' Whenever Longyue's main store gets new arrivals, people literally camp out to get their hands on her latest drops.
::'''Fuyue:''' In order to create more interesting designs and to let more customers buy their favorite clothes, Linglong has decided to open branches all over the world!
:'''Fuyue:''' With plans to expand globally, she's gotta keep that Longyue vibe while adding local characteristics.
:'''Fuyue:''' So Linglong's always on the move, soaking up inspiration from different places. I bet she's already had some amazing designs for Jinzhou!
:'''Fuyue:''' Haha, just imagine everyone here wearing Linglong's designs. Nice people in nice clothes.... It'll be fabulous!
{{Dialogue End}}
